complaint.C1: Limits and money: message caps, paywalls, price, subscriptions, billing, refunds, being charged.
complaint.C2: Refusals and restriction: won't answer, censorship, content policy, too cautious, flagged or blocked content.
complaint.C3: Wrong or made-up answers: factual errors, invented facts or sources, bad maths, confidently wrong.
complaint.C4: Forgets or loses things: memory, lost or deleted chats, loses context mid-conversation, can't find history.
complaint.C5: App broken: crashes, errors, won't load, slow, login or account access problems, voice or upload features not working.
complaint.C6: Got worse: a change made it worse than before, new model or update is a downgrade, features removed.
complaint.C7: Ignores instructions or does half the job: doesn't follow what was asked, lazy, incomplete, repeats itself, won't finish.
complaint.C8: Tone: flattering, agrees with everything, preachy, lectures, wordy, too many emojis or follow-up questions.
complaint.C9: Trust in the company: privacy, data use, account bans, politics or bias of the company or its answers, ethics.
complaint.C10: Other: anything else, or no clear subject.

praise.P1: Gets things done: work, writing, productivity, saves time, coding, organising.
praise.P2: Learning: explains things, study help, homework, teaches.
praise.P3: Company and comfort: like a friend, therapist or companion, emotional support, someone to talk to.
praise.P4: Agrees and encourages: supportive, positive, validates, never judges, makes me feel good about my ideas.
praise.P5: Advice for big decisions: health, medical, legal, money or relationship advice the user relies on.
praise.P6: Trust in its accuracy: always right, knows everything, reliable, trusts its answers.
praise.P7: Creative and fun: images, stories, games, entertainment.
praise.P8: Other: generic praise ("great app"), or no clear subject.
